verses.en: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
verses.pt: Portanto, meus amados e saudosos irmãos, minha alegria e coroa, permanecei assim firmes no Senhor, amados.
verses.en_web: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
verses.en_bbe: So my brothers, well loved and very dear to me, my joy and crown, be strong in the Lord, my loved ones.

verses.en: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.pt: Rogo a Evódia, e rogo a Síntique, que sintam o mesmo no Senhor.
verses.en_web: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: I make request to Euodias and Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.

verses.en: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.pt: E peço também a ti, meu verdadeiro companheiro, que as ajudes, porque trabalharam comigo no evangelho, e com Clemente, e com os outros meus cooperadores, cujos nomes estão no livro da vida.
verses.en_web: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.en_bbe: And I make request to you, true helper in my work, to see to the needs of those women who took part with me in the good news, with Clement and the rest of my brother-workers whose names are in the book of life.

verses.en: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
verses.pt: Regozijai-vos sempre no Senhor; outra vez digo, regozijai- vos.
verses.en_web: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
verses.en_bbe: Be glad in the Lord at all times: again I say, Be glad.

verses.en: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.pt: Seja a vossa moderação conhecida de todos os homens. Perto está o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.en_bbe: Let your gentle behaviour be clear to all men. The Lord is near.

verses.en: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.pt: Não andeis ansiosos por coisa alguma; antes em tudo sejam os vossos pedidos conhecidos diante de Deus pela oração e súplica com ações de graças;
verses.en_web: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
verses.en_bbe: Have no cares; but in everything with prayer and praise put your requests before God.

verses.en: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: e a paz de Deus, que excede todo o entendimento, guardará os vossos corações e os vossos pensamentos em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And the peace of God, which is deeper than all knowledge, will keep your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
verses.pt: Quanto ao mais, irmãos, tudo o que é verdadeiro, tudo o que é honesto, tudo o que é justo, tudo o que é puro, tudo o que é amável, tudo o que é de boa fama, se há alguma virtude, e se há algum louvor, nisso pensai.
verses.en_web: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.
verses.en_bbe: For the rest, my brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things have honour, whatever things are upright, whatever things are holy, whatever things are beautiful, whatever things are of value, if there is any virtue and if there is any praise, give thought to these things.

verses.en: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verses.pt: O que também aprendestes, e recebestes, e ouvistes, e vistes em mim, isso praticai; e o Deus de paz será convosco.
verses.en_web: The things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me: do these things, and the God of peace will be with you.
verses.en_bbe: The things which came to you by my teaching and preaching, and which you saw in me, these things do, and the God of peace will be with you.

verses.en: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
verses.pt: Ora, muito me regozijo no Senhor por terdes finalmente renovado o vosso cuidado para comigo; do qual na verdade andáveis lembrados, mas vos faltava oportunidade.
verses.en_web: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
verses.en_bbe: But I am very glad in the Lord that your care for me has come to life again; though you did in fact take thought for me, but you were not able to give effect to it.

verses.en: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
verses.pt: Não digo isto por causa de necessidade, porque já aprendi a contentar-me com as circunstâncias em que me encontre.
verses.en_web: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
verses.en_bbe: But I will not say anything about my needs, for I am able, wherever I am, to be dependent on myself.

verses.en: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verses.pt: Sei passar falta, e sei também ter abundância; em toda maneira e em todas as coisas estou experimentado, tanto em ter fartura, como em passar fome; tanto em ter abundância, como em padecer necessidade.
verses.en_web: I know how to be humbled, and I know also how to abound. In everything and in all things I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
verses.en_bbe: It is the same to me if I am looked down on or honoured; everywhere and in all things I have the secret of how to be full and how to go without food; how to have wealth and how to be in need.

verses.en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.pt: Posso todas as coisas naquele que me fortalece.
verses.en_web: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
verses.en_bbe: I am able to do all things through him who gives me strength.

verses.en: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
verses.pt: Todavia fizestes bem em tomar parte na minha aflição.
verses.en_web: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
verses.en_bbe: But you did well to have care for me in my need.

verses.en: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
verses.pt: Também vós sabeis, ó filipenses, que, no princípio do evangelho, quando parti da Macedônia, nenhuma igreja comunicou comigo no sentido de dar e de receber, senão vós somente;
verses.en_web: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
verses.en_bbe: And you have knowledge, Philippians, that when the good news first came to you, when I went away from Macedonia, no church took part with me in the business of giving to the saints, but you only;

verses.en: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
verses.pt: porque estando eu ainda em Tessalônica, não uma só vez, mas duas, mandastes suprir-me as necessidades.
verses.en_web: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
verses.en_bbe: Because even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to me in my need.

verses.en: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
verses.pt: Não que procure dádivas, mas procuro o fruto que cresça para a vossa conta.
verses.en_web: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
verses.en_bbe: Not that I am looking for an offering, but for fruit which may be put to your credit.

verses.en: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
verses.pt: Mas tenho tudo; tenho-o até em abundância; cheio estou, depois que recebi de Epafrodito o que da vossa parte me foi enviado, como cheiro suave, como sacrifício aceitável e aprazível a Deus.
verses.en_web: But I have all things, and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
verses.en_bbe: I have all things and more than enough: I am made full, having had from Epaphroditus the things which came from you, a perfume of a sweet smell, an offering well pleasing to God.

verses.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: Meu Deus suprirá todas as vossas necessidades segundo as suas riquezas na glória em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And my God will give you all you have need of from the wealth of his glory in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.pt: Ora, a nosso Deus e Pai seja dada glória pelos séculos dos séculos. Amém.
verses.en_web: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Now to God our Father be glory for ever and ever. So be it.

verses.en: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
verses.pt: Saudai a cada um dos santos em Cristo Jesus. Os irmãos que estão comigo vos saúdam.
verses.en_web: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
verses.en_bbe: Give words of love to every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you their love.

verses.en: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar’s household.
verses.pt: Todos os santos vos saúdam, especialmente os que são da casa de César.
verses.en_web: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
verses.en_bbe: All the saints send their love to you, specially those who are of Caesar's house.

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.pt: A graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o vosso espírito.
verses.en_web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
